question: Biodrop SAC Peru avocado oil manufacturer
markdown:
Biodrop S.A.C.
is a
registered Peruvian enterprise and bulk exporter
specializing in the production and commercialization of
raw avocado oil
packaged primarily in industrial volumes such as flexitanks.
Export Genius
